note: Manifest ingestion contract for official state and territorial sources. A state entry is hash-verified and its metadata validated, then recorded in source_status as registered_not_indexed: no state parser exists, so no state text enters the provision index and no state-law coverage is claimed (topic state_law stays not_acquired). An entry from a host that is not listed as a confirmed official host for its jurisdiction is rejected. Hosts are added here only after the publisher's own site has been confirmed under an operator-authorised acquisition task; the list starts empty.
